title_zh: 临时支撑与机械臂释放：可拆支撑的双 UR5 连桥装配
research_question_zh: 如何联合选择临时支撑位置、机械臂释放时机与拆除顺序，在持续承载约束下完成供料和装配，并确保支撑最终可回收？

architecture_reference.name: APEX-MR
architecture_reference.implemented_scope: Scene definition and symbolic lifecycle enumeration only; not a reproduction of the complete APEX-MR planner.

geometry.reachability_status: A-only supply is an intended layout constraint; full grasp-aware IK and collision qualification are pending.

support_tool.mechanical_design_status: conceptual_tool; gripping, actuation, tipping and extraction loads require validation

assumptions: Quasi-static vertical load balance about the left provisional connection.
Conservative support reaction ignores moment carried by the provisional connection.
Beam gravity alone exceeds the stated provisional connection allowable moment.
These calculations are design inputs, not measured force or dynamic validation.

goal_conditions: K1 and K2 are installed and permanent connections are valid.
Permanent structure supports the required load without arm or temporary support.
Temporary support has been unloaded, removed and returned to storage.
Front gate is closed and no support tool remains trapped inside.
Both arms are empty and can safely leave the assembly area.

snapshots.meaning: A holds the incomplete bridge while left-side supply remains uncollected.
Temporary support is positioned to illustrate arm release after a future load-transfer check.
Permanent closure is assembled; the temporary support remains present.
Support is returned to storage and the gate is closed.
Inner support remains in the pocket after gate closure to illustrate an extraction trap.

baselines.description: Continuous robot support with feasible handoff, support exchange and staging allowed.
Predetermined temporary support placement; same motion and load checks.
Choose support using current support feasibility without future extraction checks.
Choose support and removal order while checking load transfer, arm occupancy and extraction.

pending_validation: Full IK and collision qualification for supply, insertion, support placement and extraction grasps.
Grasped-tool and assembly collision-free paths for every lifecycle stage.
Continuous support during arm-to-tool and tool-to-permanent-structure transfer.
Ballast stability, contact wrench feasibility, friction and connection strength.
Actual retractable-shoe mechanism, unloading force and extraction actuation.
APEX-MR-compatible mode allocation, sequential reference paths and TPG generation.
Dynamic execution and independent event, geometry and load verification.
Repeated trials and fair baseline comparisons.
